name: Mercenary Desert Spears

attributes.name: Expert Charge Defence
attributes.text: This unit’s melee attack and damage are increased against charging enemies.

attributes.name: Hide (forest)
attributes.text: This unit can hide in forests until enemy units get too close.

short: Give a man a spear and hope he knows end from end. The desert takes no prisoners.
history: The desert is a harsh and unforgiving place, yet it is home to many all the same. The Tuareg, an offshoot of the Berber people, for instance, lived a nomadic life in the Sahara. They travelled in small tribes, only unifying occasionally for trade and celebration. Life in the desert necessitated the mastery of camels for both civil and military applications. It also required a reliance on a more fluid, hit-and-run style of fighting. Men from the desert fought swiftly, from the saddle, striking and vanishing again before the enemy had a chance to engage.
strengths: Very low damage and armour penetration
